verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents Blink reaching into other apps' sandboxes, such as through iOS file providers or mounting another app's folders. 'Blink Files' covers only local projects and remote machines. Dragging text selections between apps is a related clipboard feature, not file or repository access. Remote transfers via scp, sftp and curl are a different capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access and work with files and repositories from other apps' sandboxes on my device
